Not introduced by this iteration — reproduced in iter-407. Root cause is likely a stray whitespace/text child inside a <View> somewhere in the procedure detail rendering chain. Reference: /app/frontend/app/procedures/[id].tsx (parent screen)

action_items: Consider adding proper testID (not data-testid on View) to `zyg-conventional-divider`, `add-implant-btn` when rendered inside zygoma flow, and `pending-implant-tooth-*` chips so Playwright locators find them reliably. React Native Web only forwards `testID` (which becomes data-testid on DOM); using raw `data-testid` prop on <View> may be filtered out by react-native-web unknown-prop policy in some cases (locator counts returned 0 despite visible presence). Not a functional bug — UI is correct — only a testability concern.
Investigate & fix pre-existing 'Unexpected text node' warning on procedure detail page (present since before iter-407).
